description_en: Creates an automatic scaling configuration that enables the system to automatically increase or decrease compute resources based on configured elastic scaling rules to meet cluster workload requirements. During the creation procedure, you can specify elastic scaling metrics and thresholds, scale-out order, and cool-down periods
description_zh: 您可以创建自动弹性伸缩配置，让系统能够按照配置的伸缩规则自动增加或减少计算资源，满足您的集群工作负载的需求。创建过程中，您可以指定扩缩容的度量指标和阈值、扩容顺序、静默时间等
name: CreateAutoscalingConfig

parameters.help_en: The delay for triggering scale-in. This is the time interval between detecting a scale-in requirement (reaching the scale-in threshold) and actually executing the scale-in operation (reducing the number of pods). Valid values: 1 to 60. Unit: minutes. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
缩容触发时延，从检测到有缩容需求（达到缩容阈值）到实际执行缩容操作（缩容Pod数量）之间的时间间隔。

取值范围：[1,60]，单位：分钟。

默认值：10
parameters.name: cool_down_duration

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether cluster-autoscaler evicts DaemonSet pods on nodes during scale-in. Valid values:
true: The pods are evicted.
false: The pods are not evicted
parameters.help_zh:
cluster-autoscaler缩容时，是否驱逐节点上的DaemonSet Pods。取值：
`true`：驱逐。
`false`：不会驱逐
parameters.name: daemonset_eviction_for_nodes

parameters.help_en:
The node pool scale-out order policy. Valid values:
least-waste: the default policy. If multiple node pools can be scaled out, the system selects the node pool that wastes the least resources.
random: the random policy. If multiple node pools can be scaled out, the system randomly selects a node pool.
priority: the priority policy. If multiple node pools can be scaled out, the system selects the node pool with the highest priority based on the custom scaling group order. The node pool priority is defined by the priorities parameter
parameters.help_zh:
节点池扩容顺序策略。取值：
`least-waste` ：默认策略。如果可扩容节点池有多个，从中选择一个资源浪费最少的节点池进行扩容。
`random`：随机策略。如果可扩容节点池有多个，从中任意选择一个节点池进行扩容。
`priority `：优先级策略。如果可扩容节点池有多个，会按照您自定义的伸缩组顺序，选择优先级高的节点池进行扩容。节点池优先级通过`priorities`参数定义
parameters.name: expander

parameters.help_en: The GPU scale-in threshold, which is the ratio of requested resources to total resources on a node. A GPU node can be scaled in only when this ratio is lower than the configured threshold, meaning that the CPU, memory, and GPU utilization of the node are all lower than the GPU scale-in threshold. Valid values: 0.1 to 1. Default value: 0.3, which indicates 30%
parameters.help_zh:
GPU缩容阈值，节点上Request的资源与总资源量的比值。

仅当该比值低于配置的阈值时，即节点的CPU、内存和GPU资源利用率均低于GPU 缩容阈值时，GPU节点才有可能被缩容。

取值范围：[0.1~1]。

默认值：0.3，即30%
parameters.name: gpu_utilization_threshold

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for cluster-autoscaler to wait for pod termination during node draining in a scale-in scenario. Unit: seconds. Default value: 14400
parameters.help_zh:
缩容场景下，节点排水时cluster-autoscaler等待 Pod 终止的超时时长。

单位：秒。

默认值：14400
parameters.name: max_graceful_termination_sec

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of pods allowed in each ReplicaSet before a node is scaled in. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
节点缩容前每个ReplicaSet中允许的Pod最小数量。

默认值：0
parameters.name: min_replica_count

parameters.help_en: The auto scaling priority configuration. After you create a node pool with auto scaling enabled, you can choose whether to configure the priority policy and priority configuration by referring to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/119099.html. This allows you to configure priorities for the scaling groups of specified auto scaling node pools. Valid values: 1 to 100. The value must be a positive integer. A larger value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh:
自动伸缩优先级配置，创建开启了弹性的节点池后，可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/119099.html选择是否配置优先级策略与优先级配置，为指定的自动伸缩节点池伸缩组配置优先级。

取值范围为[1, 100]，必须为正整数。数字越大，优先级越高
parameters.name: priorities

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete the corresponding Kubernetes node objects after nodes are successfully scaled in fast mode. For more information about fast mode, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/119099.html. Default value: false. Valid values:
true: Kubernetes node objects are also deleted after nodes are stopped in fast mode. Do not set this parameter to true because it may cause data inconsistency of Kubernetes objects.
false: Kubernetes node objects are retained after nodes are stopped in fast mode
parameters.help_zh:
极速模式节点缩容成功后，是否删除其对应的K8s Node对象。关于极速模式更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/119099.html 。默认值：false。取值：

`true`：极速模式停机后K8s Node对象也被删除。不建议设置为true，可能导致K8s对象数据不一致的问题。
`false`：极速模式停机后K8s Node对象保留
parameters.name: recycle_node_deletion_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow node scale-in. Valid values:
true: Scale-in is allowed.
false: Scale-in is prohibited
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许进行节点缩容。取值：
`true`：允许缩容。
`false`：禁止缩容
parameters.name: scale_down_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether cluster-autoscaler performs scale-out when the number of ready nodes in the cluster is 0. Default value: true. Valid values:
true: Scale-out is performed.
false: Scale-out is not performed
parameters.help_zh:
集群Ready节点数为0时，cluster-autoscaler是否执行扩容。默认值：true。取值：

`true`：执行扩容。
`false`：不执行扩容
parameters.name: scale_up_from_zero

parameters.help_en:
The auto scaling component type. For clusters of version 1.24 and later, the default value is goatscaler. For clusters of earlier versions, the default value is cluster-autoscaler. Valid values:
goatscaler: instant elasticity.
cluster-autoscaler: auto scaling
parameters.help_zh:
弹性组件类型，集群版本1.24及以上默认为goatscaler，以下默认为cluster-autoscaler。取值：

`goatscaler`：即时弹性。

`cluster-autoscaler`：自动伸缩
parameters.name: scaler_type

parameters.help_en: The auto scaling sensitivity, which is used to adjust the interval at which the system evaluates scaling. Valid values: 15, 30, 60, 120, 180, and 300. Unit: seconds. Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh:
弹性灵敏度，用于调整系统判断伸缩的间隔时间。

取值范围：15，30，60，120，180，300。单位：秒。

默认值：60
parameters.name: scan_interval

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether cluster-autoscaler scales in nodes that contain pods with local storage, such as EmptyDir or HostPath. Valid values:
true: The nodes are not scaled in.
false: The nodes are scaled in
parameters.help_zh:
cluster-autoscaler是否缩容包含本地存储（如EmptyDir或HostPath）的Pod所在的节点。取值：
`true`：不会缩容。
`false`：缩容
parameters.name: skip_nodes_with_local_storage

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether cluster-autoscaler scales in nodes that run pods in the kube-system namespace. This feature does not take effect for DaemonSet pods and mirror pods. Valid values:
true: The nodes are not scaled in.
false: The nodes are scaled in
parameters.help_zh:
cluster-autoscaler是否缩容运行在kube-system命名空间下的Pod所在的节点，此功能对DaemonSet Pod和Mirror Pod不生效。取值：
`true`：不会缩容。
`false`：缩容
parameters.name: skip_nodes_with_system_pods

parameters.help_en: The cool-down period. This is the time interval during which the auto scaling component does not perform scale-in after the most recent scale-out is completed. Scaled-out nodes can be evaluated for scale-in only after the cool-down period ends. Valid values: 1 to 60. Unit: minutes. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
静默时间。距离最近一次扩容完成后，弹性组件不执行缩容的时间间隔。
扩容出的节点，在静默时间过后，才能进入缩容判断。

取值范围：[1,60]，单位：分钟。

默认值：10
parameters.name: unneeded_duration

parameters.help_en: The scale-in threshold, which is the ratio of requested resources to total resources on a node. A node can be scaled in only when this ratio is lower than the configured threshold, meaning that the utilization of both CPU and memory resources on the node is lower than the scale-in threshold. Valid values: 0.1 to 1. Default value: 0.5, which indicates 50%
parameters.help_zh:
缩容阈值，节点上Request的资源与总资源量的比值。

仅当该比值低于配置的阈值时，即节点的CPU和内存资源利用率均低于缩容阈值时，节点才有可能被缩容。

取值范围：[0.1~1]。

默认值：0.5，即50%
parameters.name: utilization_threshold
